Image Color Replace

Click a color in your photo and replace it with any target color using a tolerance slider.

Files never leave your device — everything is processed in your browser.

📖 How to use

  1. Drop an image into the tool and click a color in it to sample.
  2. Adjust the tolerance slider.
  3. Pick the target color, then click Download PNG.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How does color replacement work?

Click the image to sample a source color, set how close other pixels must be (tolerance), then pick the replacement color.

Is the preview live?

Yes — the preview updates live as you change the tolerance or target color.

What is it good for?

Backgrounds, skies, clothing and solid product shots.
